# SP-003: More theoretical stages change enrichment at the same cut specification
# Candidate experiment; expected observations are not measured results.
register lv3
add v1 water 100g
add v1 ethanol 10g
new
decant v1 v2 0.5
new
new
distil v1 v3 0.1 stages 1
distil v2 v4 0.1 stages 4
inspect
